vs.title: VS — taste comparison
vs.introAnilist: Enter a friend's AniList name (with a public list) and we'll see how well you match.
vs.introInternal: Enter the name of a user registered here and we'll compare your lists.
vs.duoHeading: What should the two of you watch?
vs.duoCta: AI pick for a shared evening
vs.theyRecommend: {name} has seen these — you haven't yet
vs.clubIntro: What should the group watch? List the others' usernames separated by commas — we recommend from your shared taste.
vs.clubHow: How does the club picker work?
vs.clubHowText: For every member we compute how well the title fits their taste (0–100). The group score is 60% average + 40% minimum — weighting the lowest value protects the weakest link so nobody has a bad evening. If anyone's match would drop below 35, the title is dropped (veto). At least 2 members need known taste data; "–" means we don't have enough data about that member.
vs.clubEmpty: Not enough shared overlap — grow your lists or try fewer members.

scan.title: Let's see what your list says about you.
scan.lead: Enter your public AniList username. Without signing up we'll show you which taste islands you have, what connects them, and what your strongest personal signal is.
scan.privacy: We only read your public list and store nothing from it. The result sticks around once you create an account.
scan.genericError: Could not read that list. Try again in a moment.
scan.resultTitle: {count, plural, one {You have one connected taste island} other {You have # separate taste islands}}
scan.resultTitleDominant: Your list is one large connected mass: {name}.
scan.insightIslandsDominant: You don't have islands, you have one landmass: most of your list is {name}. The rest ({count} smaller groups) read as outcrops of it rather than separate interests.
scan.resultMeta: Based on {sample} titles, {rated} of them rated
scan.insightIslands: You have {count} separate taste islands: {names}. They don't blend into one another — you look for different things in each.
scan.insightSignature: Your strongest personal signal: {feature}. It shows up {lift}× more often in your favourites than at the bottom of your list.
scan.insightStudio: The most frequent studio among the titles you liked is {studio}, with {count} entries.
scan.insightHarsh: You rate harder than the community: {delta} points lower on average.
scan.insightGenerous: You rate softer than the community: {delta} points higher on average.
scan.insightNiche: Most of your list sits outside the mainstream ({score}/100 niche).
scan.insightMainstream: Most of your list is widely watched ({score}/100 niche).
scan.ctaText: Create an account for the full 3D graph, fit scores, and a map that keeps learning with you. The import brings over the list you just scanned.
